hold_text: PHONE-EXEC-OBSERVABLE-1018 PR 4 of 5 (manager session_01VduHYzdaXe27wTDBLSu8ao; operator decision 2026-10-18). Tier 2 by path (new routes on ict-web-api, a new CI workflow that writes one signature file on the VM through the API, and the APK job). What lands: GET /phone/exec.js (per-device bearer) serves the working-tree exec.js with its version, sha256 and the CI signature ONLY while the stored signature matches the tree byte for byte; POST /phone/exec-js-signature (DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN, fail-closed) stores {version, sha256, sig}; GET /api/diag/phone_exec_js; phone-exec-js-sign.yml signs exec.js on every push to main with an ed25519 key held only in the Actions secret PHONE_EXEC_JS_SIGNING_KEY (generated once by the workflow itself via BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN, as the APK keystore is) and publishes the signature; the APK job embeds the PUBLIC key as assets/exec_pubkey.b64. The server never signs and holds no private key. No order path change. Revert = revert this PR (the phone then gets ok:false and keeps the bundled script). AFTER MERGE: the sign workflow fires on its own push; the APK must be rebuilt (dispatch phone-executor-apk) so the public key is embedded -- that build is the ONE install.
why: operator 2026-10-18: exec.js is fetched from our own server at startup and on a version bump, pinned by version, verified with an embedded ed25519 public key, bundled copy as the fallback; signing in CI with a key in Actions secrets (checked: no existing secret fits, so the workflow originates it like the APK keystore does).
